description: Partial primitive recursion satisfies \(r(\bar x,0)\simeq g(\bar x)\) and \(r(\bar x,n+1)\simeq h(\bar x,n,r(\bar x,n))\), with strict evaluation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.recursion_equations {k : ℕ}
  (g : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction k)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction (k + 2))
  (x : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.partialRec g h
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x 0) =
      g x ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.partialRec g h
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x (n + 1)) =
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.partialRec g h
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x n)).bind
        fun a =>
        h
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x n) a)
